content_sections.heading: DERC Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the DERC Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download DERC Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: DERC Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 1 for Executive Director (Law), 1 for Joint Director (Law), and 1 for Deputy Director (Law).

content_sections.heading: DERC Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Executive Director (Law): Law Degree from a recognized University. Experience: Officers holding analogous posts on regular basis OR with 2 years regular service in Pay Matrix Level-13A / 3 years regular service in Pay Matrix Level-13. Joint Director (Law): Law Degree from a recognized University / Law School. Experience: Officers holding analogous posts on regular basis OR with 2 years regular service in Pay Matrix Level-12 / 5 years regular service in Pay Matrix Level-11. Deputy Director (Law): Law Degree from a recognized University / Law School. Experience: Officers holding analogous posts on regular basis OR with 3 years regular service in Pay Matrix Level-10 / 5 years regular service in Pay Matrix Level-8 / 8 years regular service in Pay Matrix Level-6.

content_sections.heading: DERC Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: All Posts: Maximum age limit is 56 years.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the DERC Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 26-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of DERC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Delhi Electricity Regulatory Commission (DERC) to fill various law-related positions on a deputation basis in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available under DERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts are Executive Director (Law), Joint Director (Law), and Deputy Director (Law) across multiple pay levels in the organization.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies have been announced for different law positions under this recruitment notification published by DERC.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online for DERC Recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for the advertised posts is 26 October 2026. Candidates should apply before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their applications through online mode only by visiting the official DERC website recruitment portal.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for applying?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts included in this recruitment notification is 56 years as per the prescribed norms.

faq.question: Q7. What educational qualification is required?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a Law Degree from a recognized University or Law School along with the required years of service in relevant pay matrices.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary structure for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Level-11 to Level-14 under the 7th CPC Pay Matrix, with pay scales spanning from Rs. 67,700 to Rs. 2,18,200 per month.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for DERC posts?
faq.answer: The selection process generally comprises short-listing of eligible candidates followed by a skill test or interview as deemed appropriate.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website to apply?
faq.answer: You can visit the official DERC website at https://www.derc.gov.in to access the online application portal and notification details.
